_comment: CALLS LEDGER — single source for /track-record. Two call types. TYPE=RANGE (price projection): projLow/projHigh vs market read. Grading: state=open (no reliable read) → trending (ask-side or thin sold data; provisional) → final (SOLD comps ~4 wks post-release; final grades never change). grade: hit = read inside range; miss_high = we projected too high; miss_low = too low. Signed miss% is computed on-page from the nearest range bound. TYPE=VERDICT (BUY/WAIT/SELL call, graded like a paper trade): entry = market price at call date (for pre-release calls with no market, entry = first reliable read, noted); move = entry → current read. grade: right if the move agrees with the action by ≥10% (BUY wants up, WAIT/SELL wants down), wrong if it disagrees by ≥10%, ungraded inside ±10%; final at ~8 weeks from entry, sold-based where possible. HOLD/WATCH verdicts are not ledger material. IMMUTABILITY: never edit projLow/projHigh, action, entry, or callDate after publication. Weekly scheduled run updates read/readDate/state/grade and appends new calls. POKEMON RETIREMENT (2026-08-18, Mo's decision): do NOT issue NEW Pokemon calls (cat 183454) -- the finals showed a one-directional miss_high bias = no edge in a single-driver (supply-only) market. Existing Pokemon calls still grade to FINAL on their original schedule and are NEVER deleted; /track-record renders them in a separate 'Retired' section. Sports calls (cat 212) are the active book.
